title: 暂停/播放机制不直观
description: 暂停/播放功能设计不直观，下达指令时自动取消暂停，导致玩家需要频繁手动暂停。
evidence: Pause/play feature is totally uninutive. I really don't know how to play it? It unpauses automatically when you give your character orders so you have to manually pause after each order you try to stack on your character.

evidence_items.quote: Pause/play feature is totally uninutive. I really don't know how to play it? It unpauses automatically when you give your character orders so you have to manually pause after each order you try to stack on your character.
evidence_items.description: 暂停/播放功能不直观，下达角色指令时会自动取消暂停，导致每个指令后都需手动暂停
evidence_items.quote_zh: 暂停/播放功能完全不直观。我真的不知道该怎么玩？当你给你的角色下达命令时，它会自动取消暂停，所以你必须在每个你试图给角色堆叠的命令之后手动暂停。
